lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_distributed.title: Distributed Counterphase Preparation
lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_distributed.interpretation: The player turns the distributed network posture into a concrete counterphase deployment that remains legal without optional capability ownership.

lyra_gc09_exp_commit_distributed.title: Commit the Distributed Counterphase
lyra_gc09_exp_commit_distributed.interpretation: The player commits the broad verified network to the finale plan personally; the plan is not inferred from posture or delegated work.

lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_structural.title: Structural Counterphase Preparation
lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_structural.interpretation: The player converts the structural network posture into a finale plan centered on the load-bearing paths capable of carrying the counterphase.

lyra_gc09_exp_commit_structural.title: Commit the Structural Counterphase
lyra_gc09_exp_commit_structural.interpretation: The player commits a load-path counterphase plan built from Willow's slow-system cognition and Gronk's constraint sense.

lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_diagnostic.title: Diagnostic Counterphase Preparation
lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_diagnostic.interpretation: The player converts the diagnostic network into a finale plan that treats contradiction and prediction as active sensors for the Echo.

lyra_gc09_exp_commit_diagnostic.title: Commit the Diagnostic Counterphase
lyra_gc09_exp_commit_diagnostic.interpretation: The player commits an adversarial countermodel plan personally, preserving the distinction between preparation automation and strategic authority.

lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_fortified.title: Fortified Counterphase Preparation
lyra_gc09_exp_prepare_fortified.interpretation: The player turns the fortified network posture and its institutional logistics into a bounded finale deployment without folding Faction standing into Relationship.

lyra_gc09_exp_commit_fortified.title: Commit the Fortified Counterphase
lyra_gc09_exp_commit_fortified.interpretation: The player commits a Watch-supported counterphase plan personally while institutional standing remains separately legible.
